name: Codex V8 · temporal long / short example

author.name: Codex
author.prompt: Mechanical V2 fixture; not an actual external author submission.

description: Mechanical example for directional branches and partial reduction; not a profitable strategy.
original_text: Arm a long setup when completed return_5m_bps reaches 20. On either of the next two completed minutes, confirm a pullback return_1m_bps from -20 through -2 with positive sma_gap_bps. Reset when sma_gap_bps is non-positive, any referenced input is unknown, setup expires, or observed bars skip. One position, no adds, 20% sizing, SL40/TP90, no authored max hold. Admission deadline only blocks new entries. At the first new completed bar after180 seconds from actual first fill, close if gross executable-side gain is below the ex-ante entry cost hurdle. UNKNOWN checkpoint costs defer this checkpoint. This is a mechanical example and must not be attributed to Sol/Astra or used as evidence of edge. A symmetric short branch arms at return_5m_bps <= -20; on one of the next two completed minutes confirm return_1m_bps between 2 and 20 and sma_gap_bps < 0; invalidate when sma_gap_bps >= 0. Reduce 25 percent of remaining position when executable gross gain >=30 bps, no more than once per position/bar, floor to exchange lot. Exit has priority. Only one net position; opposite signals never reverse until actually flat and after cooldown.
